name: the-eye
description: Eyes and hands on a macOS screen: drive an app or a website, see what a viewer would have noticed (fps, freezes, the spring behind a motion) and why.

args: cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && command -v bun >/dev/null || { echo 'the-eye needs bun on the PATH: https://bun.sh' >&2; exit 127; } && { [ -d node_modules ] || bun install --silent >&2; } && exec bun src/index.ts
